# datadog_rum_operation_journey_link (Resource)

Provides a Datadog RUM Operation journey link resource. This links a RUM operation to a journey. Links managed by this resource are always confirmed; an existing draft or rejected link between the same operation and journey is confirmed on creation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "datadog_rum_operation_journey_link" "checkout" {
  operation_id = datadog_rum_operation.checkout.id
  journey_id   = "<journey_id>"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `journey_id` (String) ID of the journey.
- `operation_id` (String) ID of the RUM operation.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import datadog_rum_operation_journey_link.checkout "<operation_id>:<journey_id>"
```
